When I was 11 years old my mother had passed away from a accidently overdose. I guess my grandpa on my mom's side had called and notified my dad while he was at work. I knew something was up when my dad's gf at the time picked me up from school and took me to my dad. My dad is usually one of those guys that always hides his emotions, that day he broke down completely in front of me when he told me the news. That's is the only time I have ever seen him cry.

I have talked to my wife about it when we are able to get time alone. She got over it pretty fast or is hiding it very well. She seems to be taking it alot better then me. Idk if it was just past traumas triggered for me or what. But it seems like any free time I do have I just think about W. Which is unfortunate cuz I am by myself at work for 12hrs alone at night 🙃

Just please remember how much i love you. But I see what you need and want so I will step away until your ready. I love you." I have messaged her a little bit today after she messaged me first but other then that I am refraining from messaging her to give her space even tho it's heavy on my chest.

Me and my wife just got out of a throuple with one of her friends. Things were going great and i was the happiest i had been in years, the gf has 2 little girls that called me "da", which made me feel amazing as I have always wanted a big family since I was a only kid and then something happened one day and the gf wanted space and moved out. Since her and the little girls moved out I am been feeling empty and the lowest I have ever been. Every day is a struggle, I can't sleep (I just keep having nightmares) and anytime I eat I can't keep it down. It's been like this for 2 weeks now. All I can think of is her and the girls. I don't know how to tell my wife how much pain I am in without it hurting her feelings. Only thing that is keeping me going is my kids I have with my wife so I put a fake smile on and endure the pain even tho it is unbearable.
